hypotheses.justification: The statement mentions only `GL (Fin 2) (InfiniteAdeleRing K)`, `InfinitePlace K` and `archComponent K v`. In Mathlib, `InfiniteAdeleRing K` is defined with only `[Field K]` as `(v : InfinitePlace K) → v.Completion`, and its ring instances sit in a section with variables `(K : Type*) [Field K]`. In the library, `archEval` and `archComponent` (Definitions/Def_NumberField_AdelicLevel.lean) are defined in a section with `[Field K]` (plus R-variables they do not use), so they also need only `Field K`. The proof is pure extensionality: `Units.ext`, `Matrix.ext`, `funext`, and `congrArg` on matrix entries of `h v`, with `archEval` evaluating at `v` by `rfl`. None of it uses `NumberField K`, and the statement holds for any field `K`, including when there are no infinite places. So `omit [NumberField K] in` leaves the theorem and its proof unchanged.
